Analysis.object: Protective and facilitative role of self-compassion in body appreciation, intuitive eating, disordered eating, compulsive exercise, and self-criticism for Canadian Female athletes
An updated version of the BAS was published after all study data had been collected.

(a) Explore Female athletes’ self-compassion, body and eating attitudes and behaviors overtime and within specific sport and international cultural contexts.
(b) it is unclear how body appreciation and intuitive eating are related to sport performance.

Population.object: 18-35 years; two years of sport-specific experience; had competed in the past 12 months; were currently competing at a level ranging from local to international; not currently pregnant or lactating.
local (n=28), provincial (n=22), regional (n=13), national (n=19), elite for age (n=3), international (n=5)
